topic: International Trade and the Global Economy
subject: economics

items.q: Are imports always bad for an economy?
items.correct: No — trade lets countries specialise and gives consumers choice.
items.misconception: Yes, imports always harm a country.
items.why: Comparative advantage means trade can benefit all, though there are trade-offs to manage.
